# S702 — Prices of Production (matrix-derived scalar)

**Chapter**: 7. **Status**: benchmark_only_derived. **Units**: index.

Computed as S701 base × (1 + r*_year) where r* comes from S513 (Marxian profit rate). Markup positive for all 6 benchmark years (book finding confirmed). Range [2.95, 71.45].

## Refinement note

A fully-faithful S702 would solve the linear system p = a₀(1+r) + Ap for the price vector. Scalar approximation here captures the qualitative finding that prices systematically exceed labor values via the profit-rate markup.
